versions.headline: 維拉近況好又有對賽優勢，稍看高主隊
reasons: 維拉近5場3勝，剛2-1贏曼城，對賽富勒姆8勝2負
富勒姆連贏兩場1-0，但雙方進球都偏少（每場約1球）
維拉控球少、富勒姆每場約6個角球，角球估計客隊較多
versions.headline_en: In-form Villa with a strong head-to-head record get a slight edge
reasons_en: Villa have 3 wins in 5, including 2-1 over Man City, and lead the head-to-head 8-2
Fulham have won two straight 1-0, but both teams score only ~1 per game
Villa see less of the ball and Fulham average ~6 corners, so the away side should win more corners

versions.headline: 維拉主場稍佔優，但富勒姆防守穩，1-1或維拉小勝較可能
reasons: 首發已確認，維拉派出 Goretzka、Kamara 坐鎮中場，McGinn、N. Jackson 在前；Onana、Wan-Bissaka、Ruggeri 傷停早已計入，沒有新的意外缺陣
賠率略為傾向主隊（去水後約47%），維拉近況3勝，對賽富勒姆8勝2負，主勝稍為上調
兩隊每場進球都只有約1球，富勒姆連續兩場1-0，所以進球偏少，半場最可能0-0
裁判 Samuel Barrott 平均每場犯規20.4次、黃牌3.0張；加上我過往低估犯規和全場黃牌，所以把這兩項上調，上半場黃牌則保守估計
versions.key_changes: 首發確認後沒有意外缺陣，賠率稍為傾向主隊，所以主勝由45%調高到47%；按過往偏差校正：全場犯規和黃牌上調，上半場角球略升，上半場黃牌維持偏低
versions.headline_en: Villa slight favourites at home, but Fulham are solid; 1-1 or a narrow Villa win most likely
reasons_en: Lineups confirmed: Villa start Goretzka and Kamara in midfield with McGinn and N. Jackson up front; Onana, Wan-Bissaka and Ruggeri were already known absentees, no new surprises
Market leans slightly to the hosts (~47% de-vigged); Villa have won 3 of their last 5 and lead the H2H 8-2, so the home-win chance is nudged up
Both sides average only about 1 goal a game and Fulham have won their last two 1-0, so a low-scoring game is expected and 0-0 is the most likely half-time score
Referee Samuel Barrott averages 20.4 fouls and 3.0 yellows a game; combined with my past underestimation, full-time fouls and cards are raised, while first-half cards stay conservative
versions.key_changes_en: Lineups confirmed with no surprise absences and odds leaning slightly to the hosts, so the home win goes from 45% to 47%; bias calibration: full-time fouls and cards raised, first-half corners up slightly, first-half cards kept low

versions.headline: 伯恩茅斯狀態回勇稍佔優，利茲聯防守硬淨，細球格局
reasons: 伯恩茅斯連勝兩場，作客3-0大勝曼聯，主場對桑德蘭 xG 達4.23
利茲聯8場只失6球、5場平局，防守組織好，但進球能力一般
兩隊犯規都多（每場約13次），不過裁判 Salisbury 出牌少，黃牌估計約4張
versions.headline_en: In-form Bournemouth slight favourites against a tight Leeds defence; low-scoring profile
reasons_en: Bournemouth have won two straight, including a 3-0 away win at Man United, and posted 4.23 xG at home to Sunderland
Leeds have conceded only 6 in 8 with 5 draws – well organised but limited in attack
Both sides foul a lot (~13 per game), but referee Salisbury shows few cards; around 4 cards expected

versions.headline: 布倫特福德主場看高一線，森林進球乏力但 xG 不差
reasons: 布倫特福德主場曾3-0贏切爾西，本季只輸1場，不過 Yarmoliuk 停賽、Henry 傷缺
森林8場只入6球，排第18位，但近兩場作客 xG 都超過2，運氣差多於實力差
兩隊每場犯規都約14次，裁判 England 平均3.6黃牌，黃牌約4張
versions.headline_en: Brentford slight home favourites; Forest struggle to score despite decent xG
reasons_en: Brentford beat Chelsea 3-0 at home and have lost only once, though Yarmoliuk is suspended and Henry injured
Forest have scored just 6 in 8 and sit 18th, but posted 2+ xG in recent away games – more bad luck than lack of quality
Both teams commit ~14 fouls per game; referee England averages 3.6 cards, so around 4 expected

versions.headline: 切爾西主場稍佔優，但兩隊狀態都差，平局機會不低，只供參考
reasons: 切爾西主場兼排名較高，市場和統計模型都給主勝約五成多；不過切爾西聯賽連輸兩場，主場0-2負熱刺，週三聯賽杯作客利物浦打足120分鐘再互射點球出局，體力是隱憂
切爾西後防傷兵多： Lacroix、James、Martinez 缺陣，Hato也確定缺席，Chavarría可以復出頂上左後衛；加上 Joao Pedro 不在，鋒線主要靠 Welbeck 和 Palmer
曼聯近況極差（聯賽主場0-3負伯恩茅斯，歐聯1-4負Como），Sesko 長期缺陣，Rashford 成疑；不過 Carrick 面臨下課壓力，曼聯會拼盡全力，而且對賽紀錄曼聯4勝4和2負，不怕切爾西
裁判 Bankes 平均每場4.6黃牌、24次犯規，曼聯落後時會踢得更兇，黃牌和犯規估計偏多；角球方面切爾西主場應佔較多控球，所以角球估計略多於模型
versions.headline_en: Chelsea slight home favourites, but both sides are in poor form and a draw is very possible. Reference only.
reasons_en: Chelsea are at home and higher in the table, and both the market and the model give them a win chance in the low-to-mid 50s. But they have lost two league games in a row, including 0-2 at home to Spurs, and played 120 minutes plus penalties at Anfield in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday, so fatigue is a worry.

Chelsea's defence is badly hit by injuries: Lacroix, James and Martinez are out, and Hato is confirmed absent too. Chavarria is back and can fill in at left-back. With Joao Pedro out, the attack relies mainly on Welbeck and Palmer.

United's form is awful (0-3 at home to Bournemouth, 1-4 to Como in the UCL). Sesko is out long-term and Rashford is doubtful. But Carrick's job is under threat, so United will throw everything at this game, and their head-to-head record is good (4 wins, 4 draws, 2 losses).

Referee Bankes averages 4.6 yellow cards and 24 fouls per game, and United will get more aggressive if they fall behind, so cards and fouls should run high. Chelsea should have more of the ball at home, so their corner count is set a bit above the model.

versions.headline: 切爾西主場稍佔優，但無正選中鋒加體力隱憂，和局機會不低
reasons: 切爾西正式首發沒有正選中鋒，前線是 Estêvão、Palmer、Rogers；Joao Pedro 缺陣，進球效率成疑
切爾西週三聯賽杯打足120分鐘，聯賽又連輸兩場，主場0-2負熱刺時 xG 只有0.47
曼聯 Rashford 不在首發，Šeško 缺陣，但 Fernandes、Cunha、Mbeumo 齊上，反擊有威脅，對賽紀錄亦佔上風
裁判 Bankes 平均每場4.6黃牌、24次犯規，賽事膠著，黃牌估計約5張
versions.key_changes: 主勝由51%下調至44%，貼近市場：首發確認切爾西沒有正選中鋒、由年輕門將 Penders 把關，加上週中打了120分鐘，體力有隱憂；曼聯客勝由24%升至30%。
versions.headline_en: Chelsea slight home edge, but no recognised striker and fatigue keep the draw very live
reasons_en: Chelsea's confirmed XI has no recognised striker – Estêvão, Palmer and Rogers lead the line with Joao Pedro out
Chelsea played 120 minutes in the League Cup midweek and lost their last two league games, managing just 0.47 xG at home to Spurs
United are without Rashford (not in XI) and Šeško, but Fernandes, Cunha and Mbeumo all start, carry counter threat, and United lead the head-to-head
Referee Bankes averages 4.6 cards and 24 fouls per game; around 5 cards expected in a tight match
versions.key_changes_en: Home win cut from 51% to 44%, closer to the market: the confirmed XI has no striker, young keeper Penders starts, and midweek 120-minute fatigue; United win raised from 24% to 30%.

versions.headline: 榜尾大戰，桑德蘭稍佔優，但和局機會高
reasons: 兩隊都只入6球，進攻都弱，上半場0-0機會最大
考文垂主場曾4-1贏紐卡斯爾，但近兩場都輸，傷兵包括 Amenda、Wright、Woolfenden
桑德蘭剛以0-0逼和利茲聯，止住四連敗，市場看好客隊
versions.headline_en: Relegation six-pointer: Sunderland slight edge but a draw is very possible
reasons_en: Both sides have scored only 6 goals; weak attacks make a goalless first half the likeliest
Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1 at home but have lost two straight, missing Amenda, Wright and Woolfenden
Sunderland ended a four-game losing run with a 0-0 against Leeds; the market leans to the away side

versions.headline: 實力接近，五後衞的赫爾城難輸，1-1最可能
reasons: 赫爾城排5-4-1，平局4場，主場不易被攻破，但近5場未贏
伊普斯維奇攻力不錯但防守漏，8場失16球
赫爾城每場被開約6.5個角球，伊普斯維奇自己角球少，角球估計均分；赫爾城黃牌偏多
versions.headline_en: Evenly matched; Hull's back five are hard to beat – 1-1 most likely
reasons_en: Hull play 5-4-1 with 4 draws and are hard to break down at home, though winless in five
Ipswich carry a decent attack but leak goals – 16 conceded in 8
Hull concede ~6.5 corners a game while Ipswich win few themselves, so corners roughly even; Hull pick up more cards

versions.headline: 強隊緊湊對決，阿森納稍佔優但和局機會高
reasons: 阿森納8戰7勝只失5球，但 Saka、Saliba 缺陣，Madueke、Calafiori 成疑
利物浦缺 Ekitiké、Frimpong、Bradley，Szoboszlai 成疑，週三聯賽杯打足120分鐘
兩強對決通常保守，上半場0-0機會最大；利物浦每場犯規近14次，加上裁判 Madley，黃牌估計偏多
versions.headline_en: Tight big-six clash: Arsenal slight edge but a draw is very possible
reasons_en: Arsenal have 7 wins in 8 and conceded just 5, but Saka and Saliba are out and Madueke and Calafiori doubtful
Liverpool miss Ekitiké, Frimpong and Bradley, Szoboszlai is doubtful, and they played 120 minutes in the League Cup midweek
Big clashes tend to be cagey – 0-0 at half-time most likely; Liverpool commit ~14 fouls a game and with referee Madley, cards should run high

versions.headline: 兩強互有傷兵，阿森納稍佔優，和局機會仍高
reasons: ESPN 報 Madueke 傷出，加上 Saka 缺陣、Dowman 停賽，阿森納邊路幾乎無人可用，Arteta 可能要用 Havertz 或邊後衛位置頂上
利物浦 Szoboszlai 很可能缺陣，Jacquet 週五未有操練，週三聯賽杯又打足120分鐘，體能成疑
賠率繼續向阿森納傾斜（客勝約40%），兩強對決上半場0-0機會最大
裁判 Madley 本季平均4張黃牌，利物浦犯規多，黃牌估計約4至5張
versions.key_changes: 客勝由37%調高到39%：賠率走向阿森納，而利物浦 Szoboszlai 很可能缺陣、Jacquet 成疑；Madueke 缺陣抵消了部分。角球按過往低估的偏差上調，上半黃牌按過往高估的偏差下調。
versions.headline_en: Both sides hit by absences; Arsenal slight edge, draw still very live
reasons_en: ESPN lists Madueke out; with Saka injured and Dowman suspended, Arsenal have almost no wingers left and Arteta may use Havertz or a full-back out wide
Liverpool likely without Szoboszlai, Jacquet missed Friday training, and they played 120 minutes in midweek
The odds keep moving towards Arsenal (about 40% away win); 0-0 is still the most likely half-time score in a big-team clash
Referee Madley averages 4 yellows a game and Liverpool foul a lot; expect around 4-5 cards
versions.key_changes_en: Away win raised from 37% to 39%: the odds are moving towards Arsenal, Szoboszlai is likely out and Jacquet is a doubt, partly offset by Madueke's absence. Corners raised to correct past underestimates; first-half cards lowered to correct past overestimates.

versions.headline: 兩強實力接近，阿森納略佔優，但安菲爾德主場加上市場回調，平局機會不小
reasons: Arteta 表示 Rice、Calafiori、Tzolis 已恢復訓練，預計可以上場，Madueke 也未被排除，阿森納邊路並不像之前估計的那麼缺人；但 Saka、Saliba 缺陣、Dowman 停賽仍是實質損失
利物浦方面 Szoboszlai、Muñoz 仍然成疑，Iraola 暗示兩人不太可能首發，進攻主要依靠 Isak（近6場聯賽進6球）與 Barcola 的配合
賠率由開盤主勝3.25回落到2.75，客勝由2.1升到2.5，市場明顯回調向利物浦；阿森納已經十多年沒在安菲爾德贏過聯賽
兩強對決節奏偏緊，上半場0-0最可能；裁判 Madley 本季平均4張黃牌，黃牌總數預計約4至5張，總進球略為下調以校正過去高估的偏差
versions.key_changes: 客勝由39%降到38%，主勝由33%升到34%：最新消息指 Madueke 未被排除、Tzolis 回歸，阿森納邊路危機減輕，但賠率回調向利物浦，兩者大致抵消。另外為校正過去高估進球、低估角球的偏差，大2.5球下調到47%，角球略為上調。
versions.headline_en: Evenly matched heavyweights with Arsenal a slight edge, but Anfield and a market drift toward Liverpool keep the draw very live
reasons_en: Arteta says Rice, Calafiori and Tzolis are back in training and expected to be available, and Madueke has not been ruled out, so Arsenal's wings are less depleted than feared; Saka and Saliba are still out and Dowman is suspended
Liverpool's Szoboszlai and Muñoz remain doubts, and Iraola hinted neither is likely to start; the attack leans on Isak (6 goals in his last 6 league games) linking with Barcola
Odds have moved from 3.25 to 2.75 on Liverpool and from 2.1 to 2.5 on Arsenal, a clear market shift toward the hosts; Arsenal haven't won a league game at Anfield in over a decade
A tight big-team game makes 0-0 at half-time the likeliest; referee Madley averages 4 yellows this season, so expect about 4-5 cards; total goals trimmed slightly to correct past over-estimation
versions.key_changes_en: Away win down from 39% to 38% and home win up from 33% to 34%: the latest news says Madueke hasn't been ruled out and Tzolis is back, easing Arsenal's wing crisis, but the market has drifted toward Liverpool, so the two roughly cancel out. To correct past bias (goals over-estimated, corners under-estimated), Over 2.5 is cut to 47% and corners are nudged up.

versions.headline: 首發公佈後，利物浦中場和右路都缺人，阿森納 Rice、Calafiori、Madueke 全部首發，阿森納客場略佔上風，平局機會仍不小
reasons: 利物浦首發沒有 Szoboszlai 和 Muñoz：R. Araújo 改打右後衛，中場由 Nyoni 搭檔 Mac Allister，經驗較淺，進攻主要靠 Isak、Wirtz 和 Barcola
阿森納原本成疑的 Madueke 首發，Rice、Calafiori、Tzolis 也都回到首發，邊路和中場比預期完整；不過 Saka、Saliba 缺陣仍是實質損失，中後衛由 Konsa 補上
賠率在上一版之後又回到偏向阿森納（客勝 2.5→2.3，主勝 2.75→3.0），和首發名單的方向一致
兩隊三天後都要踢歐冠，比賽節奏可能偏謹慎；裁判 Madley 本季場均 4 張黃牌，黃牌總數約 4 張，總進球依照過去高估的偏差再略為下調
versions.key_changes: 首發確認後，利物浦的 Szoboszlai、Muñoz 都不在首發名單，阿森納則是 Madueke、Rice、Calafiori 全部首發，市場賠率也回到偏向阿森納，所以把客勝從 38% 調高到 41%，主勝從 34% 降到 31%；總進球略為下調（大2.5球 50%），角球微調
versions.headline_en: With the line-ups confirmed, Liverpool are short in midfield and at right-back, while Arsenal start Rice, Calafiori and Madueke. Arsenal are slight away favourites, with a draw still quite likely
reasons_en: Liverpool start without Szoboszlai and Muñoz: R. Araújo moves to right-back and the inexperienced Nyoni partners Mac Allister in midfield, so the attack relies mainly on Isak, Wirtz and Barcola

Madueke, who was doubtful, starts for Arsenal, and Rice, Calafiori and Tzolis are all back in the XI, so the flanks and midfield are stronger than expected; Saka and Saliba are still real losses, with Konsa filling in at centre-back
Since the last version the odds have moved back towards Arsenal (away 2.5→2.3, home 2.75→3.0), the same direction as the line-ups

Both sides play in the Champions League three days later, so the match may be cagey; referee Madley averages 4 yellow cards per game this season, so about 4 cards are expected, and total goals are trimmed again to correct past over-estimation
versions.key_changes_en: Confirmed line-ups leave out Szoboszlai and Muñoz for Liverpool, while Arsenal start Madueke, Rice and Calafiori, and the odds have moved back towards Arsenal. Away win raised from 38% to 41%, home win cut from 34% to 31%; total goals trimmed slightly (Over 2.5 at 50%) and corners adjusted a little

versions.headline: 曼城主場看好，布萊頓傷兵多難以擋住
reasons: 曼城8戰7勝，主場火力強，Haaland 正選，只缺 Semenyo
布萊頓攻力強（入23球），但 Mitoma、Kadıoğlu、Ferguson、Struijk 等多人缺陣，Andrés 成疑
曼城控球壓制，角球估計明顯多於對手
裁判 Pawson 平均每場27次犯規、5張黃牌，布萊頓追波時犯規和黃牌偏多
versions.headline_en: Man City favoured at home; injury-hit Brighton will struggle to hold them
reasons_en: City have 7 wins from 8 with strong home firepower; Haaland starts, only Semenyo missing
Brighton score freely (23 goals) but are without Mitoma, Kadıoğlu, Ferguson, Struijk and more, with Andrés doubtful
City's possession dominance should give them clearly more corners
Referee Pawson averages 27 fouls and 5 cards; Brighton chasing the ball means more fouls and cards on their side

versions.headline: 曼城主場仍然看高一線，但布萊頓有 C. Andrés 正選，客隊機會稍為提高
reasons: 曼城8戰7勝，Haaland 和 Doku 都正選，只缺 Semenyo，主場火力仍然佔優
之前成疑的 C. Andrés 已確認正選，布萊頓中場比預期完整，不過 Mitoma、Kadıoğlu、Ferguson 等多人仍然缺陣
曼城控球壓制，角球估計明顯多過對手
裁判 Pawson 平均每場27次犯規、5張黃牌，布萊頓追波時犯規和黃牌偏多
versions.key_changes: C. Andrés 由成疑變為正選，布萊頓中場較完整，客勝略升、主勝略降（56→55，和22→23）；其他大致不變。
versions.headline_en: Man City still favourites at home, but C. Andrés starting nudges Brighton's chances up slightly
reasons_en: City have won 7 of 8; Haaland and Doku start, only Semenyo is missing, so home firepower still has the edge
C. Andrés, previously doubtful, is confirmed in the XI, so Brighton's midfield is more complete than expected, though Mitoma, Kadıoğlu, Ferguson and others are still out
City's possession dominance should give them clearly more corners
Referee Pawson averages 27 fouls and 5 yellows per game; Brighton chasing the ball should pick up more fouls and cards
versions.key_changes_en: C. Andrés went from doubtful to starting, so Brighton's midfield is stronger: away win nudged up and home win down slightly (56→55, draw 22→23); rest roughly unchanged.

versions.headline: 紐卡斯爾主場稍佔優，埃弗頓進球乏力
reasons: 紐卡斯爾剛作客2-0贏水晶宮，但主場近況反覆，Livramento 缺陣
埃弗頓連輸兩場都0-2，8場只入8球，上半場進球極少
裁判 Brooks 平均每場5.6黃牌，黃牌估計接近5張
versions.headline_en: Newcastle slight home favourites; Everton short of goals
reasons_en: Newcastle just won 2-0 at Palace, but home form is patchy and Livramento is out
Everton lost their last two 0-2 and have scored only 8 in 8, rarely scoring before half-time
Referee Brooks averages 5.6 cards per game, so close to 5 cards expected

versions.headline: Newcastle 主場稍佔優勢，但 Miley 出戰成疑，Everton 又剛在聯賽杯 3-1 擊敗對手，最可能是 1-1 的膠著比賽
reasons: Newcastle 本季主場 4 場只贏 1 場，xG 1.18-1.88，主場優勢不明顯；4 天前聯賽杯主場 1-3 輸給同一個對手
主力中場 Miley（本季首發 7 場）出戰成疑，預計首發由 González 和 Joelinton 搭檔，中場控制力可能下降；模型無法量化單一球員的影響

16363901.verdict: 賽前預測的最可能比分 1-1 命中，勝平負卻偏向主勝（和局只有 26%）；角球和黃牌分佈也明顯失準。
points: 比分 1-1 是賽前首選，進球偏少的判斷正確；不過扳平球是 Z. Suzuki 的烏龍球，這類進球帶有運氣成分，不能算模型讀對了比賽。
半場預測 0-0 不中：N. Jackson 39 分鐘進球。上半場角球 5-2，維拉明顯壓着打，遠高於預測的 2.2 對 2.9。
全場角球 7-7，共 14 個，高於預測的 9.8；維拉角球更是低估了接近 3 個。犯規 7 對 12，維拉的犯規比預測少了 3.5 次，富勒姆則大致準確。
黃牌 1-3：富勒姆上半場已吃兩張，維拉全場只有 1 張，主隊黃牌高估、客隊低估。半場檢討把富勒姆黃牌上調到 2.9，方向正確。
xG 方面富勒姆 2.21 反而高過維拉 1.71，下半場客隊明顯反撲。半場時給主勝 68%，對領先一球的優勢估計過度樂觀。
16363901.lesson: 兩隊實力接近、預期進球偏少時，和局機率應給到 30% 左右；半場只領先一球時不要把主勝推到接近七成。另外，壓迫較多的一方犯規和黃牌通常較少，客隊的牌數應該上調。
16363901.verdict_en: The pre-match top scoreline of 1-1 was correct, but the 1X2 leaned toward a home win (draw only 26%), and the corner and card splits were clearly off.
points_en: 1-1 was the first-choice pre-match scoreline and the low-scoring read held up; however, the equaliser was a Z. Suzuki own goal, which involves luck, so it does not prove the model read the game well.
The 0-0 half-time call missed: N. Jackson scored on 39'. Villa took first-half corners 5-2 while on top, far above the predicted 2.2 vs 2.9.

Full-time corners were 7-7, 14 in total, above the predicted 9.8; Villa's corners were underestimated by almost 3. Fouls were 7 vs 12: Villa committed 3.5 fewer than predicted, while Fulham's count was roughly right.

Cards finished 1-3: Fulham already had two yellows in the first half and Villa got only one all match, so home cards were overestimated and away cards underestimated. The half-time update raising Fulham to 2.9 cards was the right direction.
On xG, Fulham's 2.21 actually beat Villa's 1.71, with the visitors clearly pushing back in the second half. The 68% home-win figure at half-time was too optimistic for a one-goal lead.
16363901.lesson_en: When two teams are close and expected goals are low, give the draw around 30%, and don't push a one-goal half-time lead to nearly 70% for the leader. The side applying more pressure usually commits fewer fouls and gets fewer cards, so raise the away team's card count.

16363902.verdict: 主勝方向正確（44%，三個結果中最高），但預測估得太接近；伯恩茅斯射正5比1，2-0贏得穩陣。
points: 勝平負方向命中；首選比分1-1落空，1-0和2-1都在候選內，實際是2-0。
角球預測主5.0、客4.3，實際4比4，偏差不大；上半場角球2比1也接近預測。
犯規12比15，利茲聯比預測多；黃牌2比2，和預測的2.0/1.9幾乎一樣，Salisbury 出牌少的判斷正確。
利茲聯控球56%，但xG只有0.67、射正1次，印證了「進球能力一般」的判斷；Evanilson 31分鐘進球後，利茲聯始終攻不破對方防線。
16363902.lesson: 狀態火熱的主隊對進球少的客隊時，應該調低和局機率，把1-0、2-0排在1-1前面。
16363902.verdict_en: Home-win direction was right (44%, the highest of the three outcomes), but the forecast was too close-call; Bournemouth won 2-0 comfortably with 5 shots on target to 1.
points_en: 1X2 direction hit; top scoreline 1-1 missed, 1-0 and 2-1 were listed, actual 2-0.
Corners forecast 5.0/4.3 vs actual 4/4, small error; 1H corners 2/1 also close.
Fouls 12/15, with Leeds above forecast; cards 2/2 almost exactly matched 2.0/1.9, confirming Salisbury's low card rate.
Leeds had 56% possession but only 0.67 xG and 1 shot on target, confirming their weak attack; after Evanilson's 31' goal they never broke Bournemouth down.
16363902.lesson_en: When an in-form home side meets a low-scoring visitor, cut the draw probability and rank 1-0/2-0 above 1-1.

16363903.verdict: 主勝方向命中（46%），但布倫特福德全場xG只有0.46，靠烏龍球和一次把握機會取勝，贏得幸運。
points: 勝平負方向正確，比分候選有1-0，實際2-0；30分鐘 Milenković 的烏龍球是模型無法預計的偶然事件。
犯規偏差最大：布倫特福德全場只犯規6次（預測12.8），森林犯規17次（預測12.5）；領先後主隊退守，追分的森林多犯規。
黃牌1比3，同樣是追分一方出牌多，總數4張和預測的4.2接近，但分佈錯了。
角球3比4，兩隊都低於預測的5.0，雙方都缺乏攻擊性，整場比賽很悶。
16363903.lesson: 早段領先的一方犯規和黃牌會明顯減少，追分一方增加；先進球的機會高時，犯規和黃牌預測應向落後一方傾斜。
16363903.verdict_en: Home-win call hit (46%), but Brentford produced only 0.46 xG and won via an own goal plus one finished chance – a fortunate win.
points_en: 1X2 direction right and 1-0 was among the scorelines, actual 2-0; Milenković's 30' own goal was a random event no model can foresee.
Fouls were the biggest miss: Brentford committed only 6 (forecast 12.8) and Forest 17 (forecast 12.5); the leading home side sat back while chasing Forest fouled more.
Cards 1/3 – again skewed to the chasing side; the total of 4 matched the 4.2 forecast but the split was wrong.
Corners 3/4, both under the 5.0 forecast; neither side was very attacking in a dull game.
16363903.lesson_en: The team that leads early fouls and gets booked much less while the chasing side does more; when one side is likely to score first, tilt foul/card forecasts toward the trailing team.

16363904.verdict: 賽前輕微看好切爾西的方向正確，但比分、犯規同黃牌都估得太保守；半場檢討時被曼聯上半場的 xG 誤導，反而轉向看淡切爾西，結果失準。
points: 勝負：賽前切爾西勝 44% 屬最大機會，方向命中；但三個熱門比分（1-1、2-1、1-2）都假設曼聯會進球，實際曼聯零進球，切爾西 2-0 贏。
下半場轉捩點是 50 分鐘 Rogers 開紀錄，之後 L. Martínez 在 59 分鐘和 63 分鐘連吃兩黃被逐，切爾西一分鐘後就由 Palmer 射入點球。紅牌加早段進球令比賽一面倒，模型完全看不到這類事件。
犯規和黃牌偏差最大：曼聯犯規 20 次（預測 11.8）、黃牌 6 張加 1 紅（預測 2.7）。全場合共 7 黃 1 紅，比原先估計的約 5 張還多；Bankes 執法偏嚴，加上落後一方追分時心急，牌數急升。
半場檢討太倚重上半場 xG（曼聯 1.01 對 0.28），把切爾西勝率降到 24%，忽略了切爾西主場控球佔優、陣容有較強的下半場調整能力；角球方面，上半場曼聯 6 對 3，最後全場卻是切爾西 8 對 7。
16363904.lesson: 遇上執法偏嚴的裁判（例如 Bankes）而且雙方實力接近時，客隊的犯規和黃牌要估高一點；半場檢討不應單憑上半場 xG 大幅推翻賽前判斷，比分仍是 0-0 時，主隊的勝率不宜砍得太多。
16363904.verdict_en: The pre-match lean towards Chelsea was right, but the scoreline, fouls and cards were badly underestimated; the half-time update was swayed by United's first-half xG and wrongly turned against Chelsea.
points_en: Result: Chelsea at 44% was the most likely outcome and it came true, but all three top scorelines (1-1, 2-1, 1-2) had United scoring, while the actual result was a 2-0 Chelsea clean sheet.

The turning point came after the break: Rogers scored on 50', L. Martínez was sent off for two yellows (59', 63'), and Palmer converted a penalty a minute later. The early second-half goal plus the red card made the game one-sided, and the model cannot see events like these.

Fouls and cards had the biggest miss: United committed 20 fouls (predicted 11.8) and got 6 yellows plus a red (predicted 2.7). The match total of 7 yellows and 1 red was even above the ~5 cards expected. Bankes was strict, and United chased the game.

The half-time update leaned too heavily on United's first-half xG (1.01 vs 0.28) and cut Chelsea's win chance to 24%. It ignored Chelsea's home possession edge and their stronger ability to adjust in the second half. Corners also flipped: United led 6-3 at half-time, but Chelsea finished ahead 8-7.
16363904.lesson_en: With a strict referee like Bankes in a tight big-team match, push the away side's fouls and cards higher. At half-time, don't overturn the pre-match view on first-half xG alone; at 0-0, keep the home side's win probability from dropping too far.

16363905.verdict: 預測錯誤：賽前看好桑德蘭（38%），結果考文垂以xG 0.71入3球，3-1大勝。
points: 考文垂xG只有0.71卻入了3球，射正4次入3球，臨門一腳遠超預期；桑德蘭xG 1.65只入了一個點球。
半場預測0-0，實際2-0；Sakamoto 17分鐘早段進球打亂了「兩隊進攻都弱」的劇本。
考文垂犯規16次，遠多過預測的11.5，領先後以犯規拖慢節奏；Alderete 90分鐘才兩黃變紅，對比賽結果沒有影響。
角球4比4，和預測的4.2/4.8大致吻合，黃牌總數4張也接近。
16363905.lesson: 不要過度依賴市場看好客隊；兩隊進攻都弱時，和局及主隊勝的機率應該更接近，並保留一方臨門一腳異常好的可能。
16363905.verdict_en: Wrong call: Sunderland were favoured (38%), but Coventry turned 0.71 xG into three goals and won 3-1.
points_en: Coventry scored 3 from 4 shots on target on just 0.71 xG – huge finishing overperformance; Sunderland's 1.65 xG yielded only a penalty.
HT forecast 0-0, actual 2-0; Sakamoto's early 17' goal broke the 'both attacks weak' script.
Coventry committed 16 fouls vs 11.5 forecast, slowing the game once ahead; Alderete's second yellow came only at 90' and did not affect the result.
Corners 4/4 broadly matched 4.2/4.8, and total cards (4) were also close.
16363905.lesson_en: Don't lean too hard on a market-favoured away side; when both attacks are weak, keep draw and home-win probabilities closer and allow for a hot finishing day.

16363906.verdict: 2-2和局，賽前三個結果的機率很平均，可算大致合理；但半場時改判伊普斯維奇58%勝出就錯了。
points: 賽前給和局28%、首選比分1-1，方向接近，實際是更多進球的2-2；半場改判客勝58%，忽略了赫爾城主場反撲的能力。
黃牌偏差最大：實際6張（3比3），預測4.3張；下半場出了5張牌，比賽到後段變得激烈。
角球赫爾城6個（預測4.4）、伊普斯維奇3個（預測4.6）；落後的主隊在下半場追分時多開角球。
伊普斯維奇控球62%、xG 1.02，但只射正3次，壓制未能轉化為優勢，McBurnie 和 Iroegbunam 10分鐘內連入兩球反超。
16363906.lesson: 半場時只領先一球、xG差距又不大，不應大幅調高領先一方的勝率；落後的主隊下半場角球和黃牌都會增加。
16363906.verdict_en: A 2-2 draw – the pre-match probabilities were fairly even and broadly reasonable, but the half-time switch to a 58% Ipswich win was wrong.
points_en: Pre-match gave the draw 28% with 1-1 as top scoreline, close in spirit; actual was a higher-scoring 2-2. The HT update to 58% away win ignored Hull's ability to fight back at home.
Cards were the biggest miss: 6 actual (3/3) vs 4.3 forecast; 5 came in the second half as the game got heated.
Corners: Hull 6 (forecast 4.4), Ipswich 3 (forecast 4.6) – the trailing home side won more corners while chasing.
Ipswich had 62% possession and 1.02 xG but only 3 shots on target; McBurnie and Iroegbunam then scored twice in 10 minutes to turn it around.
16363906.lesson_en: At half-time, a one-goal lead with a small xG gap should not push the leader's win probability up too far; a trailing home side's second-half corners and cards rise.

16363907.verdict: 方向判斷正確：客勝是最高機率選項，0-1 也列在第二個比分選項中；黃牌數量明顯低估，角球的分布也預測反了。
points: 勝平負給阿森納 41%，是三個選項中最高的，賽果 0-1 也在比分選項中；半場預測 0-0，但 Havertz 第 16 分鐘就進球，半場比分沒有猜中。
偏差最大的是黃牌：賽前預測總共約 4.2 張，實際 8 張，而且 7 張出現在下半場，80 分鐘後就有 4 張；連半場時更新的 3.5 張也還是太低。
角球總數 11 個，和預測的 10.2 個接近，但分布相反：利物浦落後後一直壓上，上半場角球 6-1，主隊 7 個角球遠高於預測的 4.9 個，阿森納只有 4 個。
利物浦射門 17 次卻只有 1 次射正，xG 也只有 1.15；落後追分時射門很多，但機會品質低。阿森納領先後退守，犯規 18-10 也主要來自主隊的逼搶。
16363907.lesson: 強隊對決如果一方早早領先，要把黃牌總數上調到比裁判場均更高（下半場和比賽末段尤其要加），角球也要往落後追分的一方傾斜。
16363907.verdict_en: Right direction: the away win was the top pick and 0-1 was the second scoreline listed. Cards were badly underestimated and the corner split came out the wrong way round.
points_en: Arsenal at 41% was the most likely of the three outcomes and 0-1 was among the listed scorelines. The 0-0 half-time call missed because Havertz scored in the 16th minute.
The biggest miss was yellow cards: about 4.2 predicted, 8 shown, 7 of them after half-time and 4 after the 80th minute. Even the half-time update of 3.5 was too low.

Total corners (11) were close to the forecast of 10.2, but the split was reversed. Liverpool pushed forward from behind and led 6-1 on corners in the first half, finishing with 7 against a forecast of 4.9; Arsenal had only 4.
Liverpool had 17 shots but only 1 on target (xG 1.15): plenty of volume while chasing, little quality. Arsenal sat deep after taking the lead, and Liverpool's pressing drove the 18-10 foul count.
16363907.lesson_en: In a tight big-team match where one side scores early, push the card total above the referee's average (especially for the second half and the closing minutes), and shift the corner forecast towards the team chasing the game.

16363908.verdict: 大冷門：預測曼城勝出（55%），結果布萊頓靠 Ayari 11分鐘進球1-0贏。
points: 曼城射門21次、xG 1.92，進球數低於表現，而 Ayari 早段進球後布萊頓退守，這種偶然性模型看不到。
角球8比2，曼城比預測的6.2多、布萊頓比預測的4.0少；一方壓制時角球差距被低估，是已知偏差。
黃牌0比3，曼城預測1.5張卻一張都沒有；布萊頓領先也出了3張牌，因為長時間防守要犯規阻止反擊。
Pawson 預計每場5張黃牌，實際只有3張，全場犯規22次，也低於他平均的27次。
16363908.lesson: 強隊主場面對防守紮實的對手，勝率不宜高於55%；一方控球壓制時，角球預測要拉開差距，被壓制一方的角球要調低。
16363908.verdict_en: Big upset: Man City were favoured (55%) but Brighton won 1-0 through Ayari's 11th-minute goal.
points_en: City had 21 shots and 1.92 xG but scored nothing, while Brighton sat deep after Ayari's early goal – randomness the model cannot see.
Corners 8/2: City above the 6.2 forecast, Brighton well below 4.0; the corner gap is underestimated when one side dominates, a known bias.
Cards 0/3: City were forecast 1.5 but got none; Brighton still collected 3 while leading, as long spells of defending meant fouling to stop counters.
Pawson was expected to show about 5 yellows but showed 3, and total fouls (22) were below his 27 average.
16363908.lesson_en: Cap a big home favourite near 55% against a well-organised defence, and widen the predicted corner gap when one side dominates possession, cutting the pinned-back side's corners.

16363909.verdict: 賽前看好 Newcastle 小勝（41%），結果 Everton 1-0 客勝，賽前判斷錯誤；半場檢討已改為傾向平局或 Everton 小勝，比較接近實際。
points: 半場 0-0 預測正確。Everton 上半場 xG 就領先（0.92 對 0.21），全場 xG 2.15 對 1.47、射正 5 對 2，客勝有場面支持，不是運氣。
黃牌總數預測 5.1 張，實際 6 張加 1 張紅牌，大致準確；但其中 3 張（含 Ramsey 兩黃變一紅）都在 90 分鐘後 Newcastle 落後追分時出現，屬於比賽尾段的情況。
角球預測 10.8 個，實際 9 個；上半場預測 5.4 個，實際只有 2 個，Everton 上半場一個角球都沒有，賽前因為過去低估而調高的修正，這場反而調過頭。
Newcastle 主場疲軟、4 天前聯賽杯 1-3 輸給同一個對手，這兩個信號賽前都已經寫進理由，卻仍然給主隊 41% 勝率，近期對戰和主場劣勢的權重明顯給得不夠。
16363909.lesson: When a home side has been losing the xG battle at home all season and just lost to the same opponent, cut the home-win probability clearly instead of trusting the home edge on paper. Decide the corner upward fix based on both teams' styles, not by default.
16363909.verdict_en: The pre-match call leaned Newcastle (41%), but Everton won 1-0 away, so the pre-match call was wrong. The half-time update shifted toward a draw or a narrow Everton win, which was closer.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was right. Everton already led on xG in the first half (0.92 vs 0.21), and the full match ended 2.15 vs 1.47 xG with 5 vs 2 shots on target, so the away win was deserved, not luck.

We predicted 5.1 yellow cards; there were 6 plus a red, so roughly right. But 3 cards, including Ramsey's second yellow, came after 90 minutes while Newcastle chased the game, which is late-game chaos.
We predicted 10.8 corners and there were 9. In the first half we predicted 5.4 and there were only 2, with Everton taking none, so our usual upward fix for corners overshot this time.

Newcastle's weak home form and their 1-3 League Cup home loss to the same opponent 4 days earlier were both in the reasoning, yet the home side still got 41%. Recent meetings and the poor home form were not weighted enough.

16363910.verdict: 勝負方向和 2-0 比分都在預測範圍內（主勝 57%，2-0 是第三選擇），但 Mateta 13 分鐘被逐，令角球、控球和射門數據遠超賽前預測。
points: 結果對：熱刺 2-0 贏，2-0 列在預測比分第三位；半場預測 0-0，實際 Gray 25 分鐘進球，熱刺 1-0 領先。
偏差最大是角球：預測 6.6 比 3.8，實際 20 比 0。水晶宮打十人後全面退守，熱刺控球 79%、射門 34 次，角球自然大增。
犯規比預測少（預測 12.5 比 11，實際 8 比 10）：一邊倒的比賽，對抗不多。黃牌總數 2 張，大致符合 Oliver 出牌少的判斷。
早段紅牌是模型看不到的因素。半場更新已改為主勝 88%、角球 11 比 1.5，方向正確，但熱刺的角球仍然估少。
16363910.lesson: 強隊對防線不穩的球隊，而對手又有機會早段少一人時，角球分佈要預留大幅一邊倒的空間；半場更新時如果對方只剩十人，強隊的全場角球可以估到 12 以上。
16363910.verdict_en: Direction and the 2-0 scoreline were in range (57% home win, 2-0 our third pick), but Mateta's 13th-minute red card pushed corners, possession and shots far beyond the pre-match forecast.
points_en: Result correct: Tottenham won 2-0, our third-listed score. We predicted 0-0 at half-time, but Gray scored on 25' for a 1-0 Spurs lead.
Biggest miss was corners: predicted 6.6-3.8, actual 20-0. Down to ten men, Palace sat deep while Spurs had 79% of the ball and 34 shots.
Fouls came in lower than expected (predicted 12.5-11, actual 8-10) because the one-sided game had few duels. Two yellows in total fits the read that Oliver shows few cards.
The early red card was invisible to the model. The half-time update (88% home win, corners 11-1.5) moved the right way but still underestimated Spurs' corners.
16363910.lesson_en: When a strong side faces a leaky defence and the opponent may go down to ten early, allow for a very lopsided corner split. In a half-time update against ten men, project 12+ full-time corners for the dominant side.
16363910._note: Reviewed in the CLI; no files were changed and nothing was looked up online.

16363901.verdict: 維拉上半場機會質素較高（xG 1.2 對 0.6），N. Jackson 39 分鐘進球領先；賽前預測半場 0-0 不中，但進球總數和犯規總數都大致接近。
points: 半場比分：預測 0-0，實際 1-0。維拉 xG 1.2、大好機會 2 次，13 分鐘 Goretzka 一次被 VAR 判不給的點球已經反映維拉在禁區內有威脅，領先合理。上半場進球預測 [0.6, 0.4]，實際 [1, 0]，大致接近。
角球：預測 [2.2, 2.9]，實際 [5, 2]。富勒姆控球較多（53%），但維拉進攻更直接，射門和角球都較多，賽前低估了維拉的角球，富勒姆則被高估。
犯規和黃牌：上半場犯規總數預測約 10.6，實際 10，總數準確，但分佈完全偏向富勒姆（2 對 8），黃牌 0 對 2（Affengruber、Bassey）。富勒姆被迫用犯規阻截維拉的反擊，裁判 Samuel Barrott 尺度偏嚴，這點與賽前判斷吻合。
16363901.headline: 下半場富勒姆要壓上追和，角球會增加；維拉可以退守打反擊，最可能守住 1-0，或者再入一球擴大領先。
16363901.changes: 主勝由 47% 升至 68%，客勝由 27% 跌至 11%，原因是維拉領先 1-0 而且 xG 佔優。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 1-0、2-0。全場角球由 [4.2, 5.6] 改為 [7.5, 5.5]：維拉上半場已有 5 個，下半場富勒姆壓上會追回一些。犯規由 [10.5, 12.0] 改為 [7.5, 13.0]：富勒姆上半場已犯規 8 次，維拉下半場守領先會多一點犯規。黃牌由 [2.0, 2.3] 改為 [1.2, 2.9]：富勒姆已有 2 張，兩名已吃黃牌的球員會收斂，但裁判尺度嚴，富勒姆追分時仍會再吃牌；維拉守領先和拖延時間，也可能吃牌。大 2.5 球約 42.5%，需要下半場再入兩球。
16363901.verdict_en: Villa created the better chances in the first half (xG 1.2 vs 0.6) and lead through N. Jackson's 39th-minute goal. The predicted 0-0 half-time score missed, but total goals and total fouls were roughly right.
points_en: Half-time score: predicted 0-0, actual 1-0. Villa had xG 1.2 and 2 big chances, and the VAR check on a possible Goretzka penalty in the 13th minute already showed their threat in the box. The lead is deserved. First-half goals were predicted at [0.6, 0.4] vs actual [1, 0], which is close.

Corners: predicted [2.2, 2.9], actual [5, 2]. Fulham had more of the ball (53%), but Villa attacked more directly and had more shots and corners. Villa's corners were underestimated and Fulham's overestimated.

Fouls and cards: total first-half fouls were predicted at about 10.6 and came in at 10, so the total was right, but the split was heavily one-sided (2 vs 8) and yellow cards went 0-2 (Affengruber, Bassey). Fulham had to foul to stop Villa's counters, and referee Samuel Barrott is strict, which matches the pre-match view.
16363901.headline_en: In the second half Fulham must push forward to equalise, so they will win more corners. Villa can sit back and counter; the most likely outcome is that they hold 1-0 or add a second goal.
16363901.changes_en: Home win raised from 47% to 68% and away win cut from 27% to 11%, because Villa lead 1-0 with the better xG. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 1-0 or 2-0. Full-time corners changed from [4.2, 5.6] to [7.5, 5.5]: Villa already have 5, and Fulham will catch up some as they push. Fouls changed from [10.5, 12.0] to [7.5, 13.0]: Fulham already have 8, and Villa will foul a bit more while protecting the lead. Cards changed from [2.0, 2.3] to [1.2, 2.9]: Fulham already have 2, and their two booked players will be careful, but with a strict referee Fulham will probably pick up more cards as they chase the game; Villa may also be booked while defending and wasting time. Over 2.5 goals is about 42.5%, as it needs two more goals in the second half.

16363902.verdict: 伯恩茅斯憑 Evanilson 31分鐘進球領先，上半場大致符合「主隊稍佔優」的預期，但半場比分預測0-0落空。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，主隊xG 0.63對0.41，進球期望值（0.65/0.4）與實際走勢相當接近
11分鐘利茲聯 Calvert-Lewin 有一次VAR判決，但比分仍是1-0，以比分為準；利茲聯控球53%，射門卻只得3次，威脅有限
犯規7對10，比預測多，主要是利茲聯偏多；黃牌1對1，與預測吻合，角球2對1略低於預測
16363902.headline: 利茲聯落後要壓上，伯恩茅斯可以打反擊再添一球，主隊守住勝果的機會較大。
16363902.changes: 賽前主勝44%，現在升到62%，因為主隊已經領先；利茲聯上半場犯規已有10次，所以全場犯規上調；大2.5球機率下調，因為還要再入兩球。
16363902.verdict_en: Bournemouth lead through Evanilson's 31st-minute goal, roughly matching the 'home slight edge' view, but the 0-0 HT call missed.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; xG 0.63 vs 0.41 was close to the expected 1H goals (0.65/0.4)
Leeds had a VAR moment with Calvert-Lewin on 11', but the score stands 1-0; Leeds had 53% possession but only 3 shots
Fouls 7 vs 10, above forecast, mostly from Leeds; yellows 1-1 as expected; corners 2-1 slightly under
16363902.headline_en: Leeds must push; Bournemouth can counter for a second and are favourites to hold on.
16363902.changes_en: Home win up from 44% to 62% after taking the lead; full-time fouls raised because Leeds already have 10; over 2.5 lowered since two more goals are needed.

16363903.verdict: 布倫特福德靠 Milenković 的烏龍球領先，但上半場是森林佔優，主隊xG只有0.15。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，進球來自烏龍球，不是布倫特福德打出來的機會
森林射門9對4，xG 0.41對0.15，符合賽前「森林運氣差多於實力差」的判斷
犯規只有3對7，遠低於預測的6.3/6.4；Milenković 烏龍之後再吃黃牌，角球2對2接近預測
16363903.headline: 森林追分會壓上，扳平機會不小；布倫特福德主要靠反擊和定位球。
16363903.changes: 主勝從46%升到55%，因為已經領先，但森林場面較好，所以沒有升太多；布倫特福德犯規少，全場犯規預測下調；森林角球上調。
16363903.verdict_en: Brentford lead via a Milenković own goal, but Forest were better; Brentford's xG was just 0.15.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; the goal was an own goal, not a Brentford chance
Forest outshot them 9-4 (xG 0.41 vs 0.15), consistent with the 'unlucky, not bad' pre-match view
Fouls only 3 vs 7, far below the 6.3/6.4 forecast; Milenković booked after his own goal; corners 2-2 near forecast
16363903.headline_en: Forest will push and have a real chance to equalise; Brentford rely on counters and set pieces.
16363903.changes_en: Home win up from 46% to 55% only, given Forest's edge in play; Brentford fouls lowered; Forest corners raised.

16363904.verdict: 上半場曼聯明顯較有威脅，xG 1.01 對 0.28、絕佳機會 3 對 1，但比分仍是 0-0；半場比分預測命中，進球、角球和黃牌部分則有偏差。
points: 半場 0-0 預測命中。不過賽前預計上半場切爾西進球 0.7 球、曼聯 0.5 球，實際走勢相反：曼聯 9 次射門、3 次絕佳機會，xG 1.01；切爾西沒有正選中鋒，xG 只有 0.28，印證了賽前對其進球效率的擔心。34 分鐘 Cunha 有一次 VAR 判決事件，數據標示為「進球有效」，但提供的半場比分仍是 0-0，兩者有矛盾，本檢討按 0-0 處理。
角球低估了曼聯：實際 3 比 6，預測是 2.5 比 2.1。正如已知偏差，一方佔優勢時角球容易被低估，雖然控球率接近五五波，但曼聯的進攻次數明顯較多。
犯規分佈預測錯：實際 3 比 8，曼聯犯規遠多於預測的 5.6，切爾西則少於 5.3。兩隊合共 11 次，與預測總數 10.9 接近。數據中沒有黃牌紀錄，所以預計 1.9 張黃牌偏高；Bankes 上半場比預期寬鬆。
16363904.headline: 下半場只剩 45 分鐘，切爾西前線欠缺破門手段，曼聯憑反擊和機會質素稍佔上風；小球和和局機會最大，若有進球，曼聯先入的機會較高。
16363904.changes: 賽前切爾西勝平負為 44/26/30，現改為 24/38/38。原因：半場 0-0 只剩半場時間，和局機率大增；上半場 xG 及絕佳機會都是曼聯佔優，切爾西又沒有中鋒，所以把主勝大幅調低。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 0-0 / 0-1。全場角球由 5.2 比 4.6 改為 6.0 比 8.5，因曼聯上半場已有 6 個。全場犯規由 11.0 比 11.8 改為 8.5 比 13.5，按上半場的犯規分佈調整。上半場沒有黃牌，全場黃牌由約 5 張調低至約 3 張，但 Bankes 一向執法嚴厲，下半場膠著時仍可能多出牌。
16363904.verdict_en: Manchester United were clearly more threatening in the first half (xG 1.01 vs 0.28, big chances 3 vs 1), yet it is 0-0. The half-time score prediction was right, but the goal, corner and card details were off.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was correct. However, we expected Chelsea to create more (0.7 vs 0.5 first-half goals), and the opposite happened: United had 9 shots, 3 big chances and 1.01 xG. Chelsea, without a recognised striker, managed only 0.28 xG, confirming the pre-match worry about their finishing. There was a VAR incident involving Cunha on 34' that the data labels 'goal awarded', but the half-time score given is still 0-0. The two conflict, and this review treats the score as 0-0.

Corners underrated United: 3-6 actual vs 2.5-2.1 predicted. This matches the known bias that corners get underestimated when one side dominates. Possession was roughly even, but United attacked far more often.

The foul split was wrong: 3-8 actual. United fouled much more than the predicted 5.6 and Chelsea less than 5.3, although the combined total of 11 was close to the predicted 10.9. No yellow cards are recorded, so the forecast of about 1.9 was too high; Bankes was more lenient than expected.
16363904.headline_en: With 45 minutes left, Chelsea lack a cutting edge up front, while United's counter-attacks and better chances give them a slight edge. A low-scoring game or a draw is most likely; if anyone scores, United are more likely to get the first goal.
16363904.changes_en: The Chelsea win/draw/United win split moved from 44/26/30 to 24/38/38. Reason: at 0-0 with only half the game left, a draw becomes much more likely, and United led on xG and big chances while Chelsea have no striker, so the home-win chance was cut sharply. The most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0 / 0-1. Full-time corners changed from 5.2-4.6 to 6.0-8.5 because United already have 6. Full-time fouls changed from 11.0-11.8 to 8.5-13.5 to follow the first-half split. With no yellows in the first half, the card total drops from about 5 to about 3, though Bankes is usually strict and could still book more players in a tight second half.

16363905.verdict: 考文垂上半場兩球領先，賽前看好桑德蘭的判斷明顯錯了。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，Sakamoto 17分鐘、Awoniyi 37分鐘進球，xG只有0.39，射門把握很高
桑德蘭控球53%，xG卻只有0.29，只有1腳射正，進攻疲弱
犯規7對5，接近預測；考文垂 Torp 早段黃牌，角球3對1，比預測更偏向主隊
16363905.headline: 桑德蘭要壓上搶分，考文垂可以退守反擊，兩球優勢應該守得住。
16363905.changes: 賽前客勝38%最高，現在主勝升到80%；全場大2.5球大幅上調，因為只差一球；桑德蘭落後要壓上，角球上調。
16363905.verdict_en: Coventry lead 2-0 at the break; the pre-match lean towards Sunderland was clearly wrong.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; Sakamoto (17') and Awoniyi (37') scored from only 0.39 xG, very clinical finishing
Sunderland had 53% possession but just 0.29 xG and 1 shot on target
Fouls 7 vs 5 near forecast; Torp booked early; corners 3-1, more home-leaning than forecast
16363905.headline_en: Sunderland must chase; Coventry can sit deep and counter, and should hold a two-goal lead.
16363905.changes_en: Away win was the pre-match favourite at 38%; now home win is 80%; over 2.5 raised sharply since one more goal does it; Sunderland corners raised as they chase.

16363906.verdict: 伊普斯維奇控球69%，壓制赫爾城，F. Luís 22分鐘進球領先。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，伊普斯維奇控球和大機會（2對0）都佔上風，赫爾城沒有射正
赫爾城如賽前所料排低位防守，但沒能守住0-0，xG只有0.17
角球3對3，比預測略高；犯規6對5，接近預測；黃牌是客隊 Palacios 吃，不是預測偏多的赫爾城
16363906.headline: 赫爾城落後要打開陣型，伊普斯維奇會有更多反擊空間，但他們防守常有漏洞，赫爾城仍有扳平機會。
16363906.changes: 客勝從37%升到58%，因為伊普斯維奇已經領先，而且控制大局；赫爾城追分要壓上，角球上調；赫爾城黃牌比賽前預測少。
16363906.verdict_en: Ipswich dominated with 69% possession and lead through F. Luís on 22'.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; Ipswich led on possession and big chances (2-0), Hull had no shot on target
Hull sat deep as expected but couldn't hold 0-0; xG just 0.17
Corners 3-3, slightly above forecast; fouls 6-5 near forecast; the yellow went to Ipswich's Palacios, not card-prone Hull
16363906.headline_en: Hull must open up, leaving Ipswich more counter space, but Ipswich's leaky defence keeps an equaliser possible.
16363906.changes_en: Away win up from 37% to 58% with Ipswich ahead and in control; Hull corners raised as they chase; Hull cards lowered.

16363907.verdict: 利物浦控球和角球占優，但射正只有 1 次；阿森納靠 Havertz 第 16 分鐘的進球帶著 1-0 進入半場，賽前預測的方向是對的，半場比分沒有猜中。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 沒有猜中，不過上半場總進球預測約 1 球，和實際的 1 球相符；xG 0.59 比 0.77，阿森納的機會品質略好，領先是合理的。
角球偏差最大：預測 2.4 比 2.7，實際 6 比 1。阿森納早早領先後退守，利物浦長時間在對方半場傳中，正好是模型已知的弱點：一方壓制時會低估角球。
犯規 5 比 6，比預測的 7.6 比 5.0 少，利物浦比較少犯規；黃牌 1 比 0 和預測的 0.6 比 0.4 接近，是 Barcola 在第 45 分鐘吃到的。
16363907.headline: 下半場利物浦會全力壓上，角球和傳中會繼續增加；阿森納有機會打反擊擴大比分，但利物浦扳平的機率大約五成多。
16363907.changes: 賽前是勝平負 31/28/41、最可能比分 1-1；現在阿森納領先，客勝提高到 61%，最可能比分改成 0-1。全場角球從 4.9 比 5.3 改成 10.0 比 3.0，因為利物浦落後要持續壓制。犯規改成 11 比 13，阿森納下半場防守和拖延時間會多犯規。黃牌改成 2.0 比 1.5：裁判 Madley 本季場均 4 張，阿森納下半場拖延時間容易吃牌，Barcola 已有一張黃牌會收斂。
16363907.verdict_en: Liverpool had more of the ball and the corners, but only 1 shot on target; Arsenal lead 1-0 at half-time through Havertz (16'). The pre-match lean towards Arsenal was right, the 0-0 half-time call was not.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score was wrong, but the predicted ~1 first-half goal matched. xG was 0.59 vs 0.77, so Arsenal's chances were slightly better and the lead is deserved.

Corners were the biggest miss: predicted 2.4 vs 2.7, actual 6 vs 1. After the early goal Arsenal sat deep while Liverpool kept crossing. This is the model's known blind spot: it underestimates corners when one side dominates.
Fouls were 5 vs 6, lower than the predicted 7.6 vs 5.0 (Liverpool fouled less than expected). Cards at 1-0 were close to the predicted 0.6 vs 0.4; Barcola was booked in the 45th minute.
16363907.headline_en: Liverpool will push hard in the second half, so expect more corners and crosses. Arsenal can hit them on the break, but Liverpool have a bit better than a 50% chance of scoring at least once.
16363907.changes_en: Pre-match was 31/28/41 with 1-1 the likeliest score. With Arsenal ahead, the away win rises to 61% and 0-1 is now the likeliest score. FT corners go from 4.9 vs 5.3 to 10.0 vs 3.0 because Liverpool will keep pressing while behind. Fouls are now 11 vs 13, as Arsenal defending and wasting time leads to more fouls. Cards are now 2.0 vs 1.5: Madley averages 4 cards a game this season, Arsenal time-wasting tends to draw bookings, and Barcola, already on a yellow, will hold back.

16363908.verdict: 布萊頓 Ayari 11分鐘進球，客隊領先；曼城控球55%但只有1腳射正，賽前預測半場1-0主隊領先錯了。
points: 半場比分預測1-0錯，xG 0.55對0.58，曼城預測上半進球0.9是高估了
曼城射門7對3，但布萊頓大機會2對1，反擊更有效率
角球3對1、犯規3對6，方向與預測一致；布萊頓 C. Andrés 已有黃牌，下半場要收斂
16363908.headline: 曼城會全力壓上，Haaland 和 Doku 會有更多機會，布萊頓要頂住壓力，再找反擊機會。
16363908.changes: 主勝從55%降到26%，客勝升到46%，因為布萊頓領先而且機會質素不差；曼城追分壓上，角球上調到8.5；布萊頓要拖延和防守，犯規和黃牌偏多。
16363908.verdict_en: Brighton lead through Ayari on 11'; City had 55% possession but one shot on target, so the 1-0 home HT call was wrong.
points_en: 1-0 HT call wrong; xG 0.55 vs 0.58, City's 0.9 expected 1H goals was too high
City outshot them 7-3, but Brighton had more big chances (2-1) and were more efficient on the break
Corners 3-1 and fouls 3-6 match the forecast direction; C. Andrés is on a yellow and must be careful
16363908.headline_en: City will throw everything forward with Haaland and Doku; Brighton must absorb pressure and hit on the break.
16363908.changes_en: Home win cut from 55% to 26%, away win up to 46% with Brighton ahead and creating good chances; City corners raised to 8.5 as they chase; Brighton fouls and cards stay high as they defend and slow the game.

16363909.verdict: 半場 0-0 和賽前預測一致，但 Everton 在場面上明顯佔優（xG 0.92 對 0.21、射門 10 對 5），Newcastle 主場依然打不出威脅。
points: 半場比分 0-0 預測正確：預測的上半場進球期望是 0.6 對 0.4，雙方都沒有進球，符合 Everton 作客上半場很少進球的趨勢；不過 Everton 有 1 次絕佳機會沒有把握住，差點被打破。
角球偏差：預測 3.0 對 2.4，實際 2 對 0。控球各 50%，Everton 主要靠射門製造威脅，沒有轉化成角球，所以客隊角球被高估。
犯規和黃牌：犯規 7 對 7，比預測的 5.8 對 5.0 高，賽前預期「剛交手過的火氣」確實出現；黃牌只有 Burn 32 分鐘的 1 張，裁判 John Brooks 上半場尺度比他的場均寬鬆。
16363909.headline: 下半場進球通常會比較多，但兩隊整體效率偏低；Everton 機會品質較好，Newcastle 主場需要主動壓上，角球可能向主隊傾斜。
16363909.changes: 勝平負由 41/27/32 改為 29/39/32：半場 0-0，只剩 45 分鐘，平局機率大幅上升；Newcastle 上半場 xG 只有 0.21，主勝機率下調。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 0-0。全場角球由 5.9/4.9 改為 5.0/2.8，因為 Everton 上半場 0 個角球，下半場 Newcastle 需要追分。犯規由 12/10 上調到 13.5/13，因為上半場已有 7/7。黃牌由 2.6/2.5 下調到 2.2/2.0，因為上半場只出現 1 張，Burn 吃牌後也會收斂。
16363909.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted, but Everton were clearly better (xG 0.92 vs 0.21, shots 10 vs 5) while Newcastle again created little at home.
points_en: HT 0-0 correct: expected 1H goals were 0.6 vs 0.4 and neither side scored, matching Everton's low-scoring first halves away, although Everton missed one big chance.
Corners were off: predicted 3.0 vs 2.4, actual 2 vs 0. With possession at 50-50, Everton's threat came from shots rather than corners, so the away corner number was too high.

Fouls 7 vs 7 were above the 5.8 vs 5.0 forecast, so the expected tension from the recent cup meeting showed up. There was only 1 yellow (Burn, 32'), and John Brooks was more lenient than his season average.
16363909.headline_en: Second halves usually bring more goals, but both sides have been inefficient. Everton have the better chances, and Newcastle must push at home, which should tilt corners their way.
16363909.changes_en: 1X2 moved from 41/27/32 to 29/39/32: at 0-0 with 45 minutes left the draw is much more likely, and Newcastle's 0.21 1H xG cuts the home win. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0. Corners went from 5.9/4.9 to 5.0/2.8 because Everton had 0 in the 1H and Newcastle will push. Fouls went up from 12/10 to 13.5/13 after 7/7 at HT. Cards went down from 2.6/2.5 to 2.2/2.0 because there was only 1 in the 1H and Burn will be careful on a yellow.

16363910.verdict: Mateta 13 分鐘被 VAR 改判紅牌後，水晶宮只剩十人，熱刺全面壓制，上半場 1-0 領先完全合理。
points: 半場比分預測錯誤：賽前估 0-0。主要原因是 Mateta 早段被逐離場，熱刺之後控球 78%，第 25 分鐘由 A. Gray 進球。熱刺上半場預計入 0.75 球，實際入 1 球，算是接近；水晶宮預計入 0.35 球，實際 0 球，xG 只有 0.04。
角球方向正確，但數量低估：預測 3.0 比 1.7，實際 6 比 0。賽前已指出熱刺會控球多、角球大幅領先，紅牌令這個差距再擴大，與「一方壓制時模型會低估角球」的已知偏差一致。
犯規及紙牌：犯規預測 6.0 比 5.6，實際 5 比 7，大致準確，十人應戰的水晶宮要靠犯規阻截。黃牌方面熱刺 1 張（A. Gray），水晶宮 0 黃 1 紅；模型無法預見早段直紅，裁判 Oliver 出牌少的判斷大致成立。
16363910.headline: 熱刺領先一球，下半場還有 45 分鐘多打一人，大機會控制局面再添進球；水晶宮只能靠反擊或定位球。
16363910.changes: 主勝由 57% 升至 88%，原因是領先一球加上對手十人，和局及客勝大幅下降。最可能比分由 1-0 改為 2-0。熱刺全場角球由 6.6 升至 11.0，水晶宮由 3.8 降至 1.5，因為十人隊伍難以壓上。水晶宮犯規由 11.0 升至 13.0，因為少一人要多阻截；熱刺犯規由 12.5 降至 9.5，因為控球多、少需要犯規。水晶宮黃牌由 2.1 降至 1.6，因為上半場 0 黃，而且少一人後落後方多數收斂；熱刺黃牌維持 1.6。大 2.5 球機率為 39%，兩隊皆進球只有 21%。
16363910.verdict_en: Mateta's VAR-upgraded red card in the 13th minute left Palace with ten men; Spurs dominated and deserve their 1-0 half-time lead.
points_en: The half-time score call was wrong: we predicted 0-0. Mateta's early dismissal was the main reason. Spurs then had 78% possession and A. Gray scored in the 25th minute. Spurs' expected 0.75 first-half goals was close to the actual 1; Palace's expected 0.35 compares with 0 goals and only 0.04 xG.

Corners went the right way but the count was too low: we predicted 3.0 vs 1.7 and the actual was 6 vs 0. The pre-match view that Spurs would have more of the ball and win the corner count was right, and the red card widened the gap. This matches the known bias of underestimating corners when one side dominates.

Fouls and cards: fouls were predicted at 6.0 vs 5.6 and came in at 5 vs 7, roughly accurate, with ten-man Palace fouling to stop attacks. Cards: Spurs 1 yellow (A. Gray), Palace 0 yellows and 1 red. The model could not foresee an early straight red; the read that referee Oliver shows few cards mostly held.
16363910.headline_en: Spurs lead by one with 45 minutes left against ten men and should control the game and likely add more; Palace can only hope for counter-attacks or set pieces.
16363910.changes_en: Home win rises from 57% to 88% because of the one-goal lead against ten men; draw and away win drop sharply. Most likely score changes from 1-0 to 2-0. Spurs full-time corners rise from 6.6 to 11.0 and Palace's fall from 3.8 to 1.5, as a ten-man side struggles to push forward. Palace fouls rise from 11.0 to 13.0 because a man down they must stop more attacks; Spurs fouls fall from 12.5 to 9.5 because they have most of the ball and need to foul less. Palace yellows fall from 2.1 to 1.6 because they had no yellows in the first half and a side down to ten men usually plays more carefully; Spurs yellows stay at 1.6. Over 2.5 goals is 39% and both teams to score only 21%.

16363914.verdict: 半場 0-0 和預測一致，但場面比預期平均：Coventry 的 xG 和射門都比 Everton 多，Everton 的主場優勢沒有體現出來。
points: 半場比分 0-0 猜中；預測上半場合計約 1.0 球（Everton 0.7、Coventry 0.3），實際兩隊都沒有進球。下毛毛雨、雙方進攻效率偏低，進球數下調的方向是對的。
攻勢方向和預期相反：Coventry 射門 8 次對 4 次，xG 0.64 對 0.28，還有全場唯一一次絕佳機會。Everton 控球 52% 卻只有 1 腳射正，預測高估了主隊上半場的威脅。
角球 1-1，比預測的 2.6/2.2 少很多；犯規 5-4，Everton 比預期多，Coventry 比預期少；兩隊都沒有黃牌，低於預測的 0.5/0.8，裁判 Attwell 上半場吹得比較寬鬆。
16363914.headline: 下半場只剩 45 分鐘，0-0 的基礎上 Everton 仍略占優勢，但 Coventry 表現不弱；第一個進球很可能決定勝負，平局機率最高。
16363914.changes: 主勝從 56% 降到 35%，平局從 25% 升到 39%，客勝從 19% 升到 26%：已經 0-0 過了半場，比賽時間縮短一半，而且 Coventry 上半場的機會品質比 Everton 好。最可能比分改為 0-0、1-0、1-1（賽前是 1-0、2-0、1-1）。全場角球從 5.3/4.2 下調到 4.0/3.6，因為上半場只有 1-1。全場犯規 Everton 從 9.5 升到 10.5，Coventry 從 12.5 降到 10.0。黃牌因上半場沒有出牌而下調，但 Attwell 本季出牌偏多，下半場比賽變緊後仍可能出牌。
16363914.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted, but the game was more even than expected: Coventry had more xG and more shots, and Everton's home edge didn't show.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score was correct. We expected about 1.0 first-half goals (Everton 0.7, Coventry 0.3) and neither side scored. Light rain and blunt attacking made the lower goals call look right.

The run of play went the other way: Coventry had 8 shots to 4, 0.64 xG to 0.28 and the only big chance. Everton had 52% of the ball but just 1 shot on target, so we overrated the home side's first-half threat.

Corners were 1-1, well under the predicted 2.6/2.2. Fouls were 5-4, with Everton above our number and Coventry below it. There were no cards against our 0.5/0.8, as Attwell let play go on in the first half.
16363914.headline_en: With 45 minutes left at 0-0, Everton still have a slight edge, but Coventry have looked good. The first goal will probably decide it, and a draw is the single most likely result.
16363914.changes_en: Home win cut from 56% to 35%, draw up from 25% to 39%, away win up from 19% to 26%: the game is goalless at the break, only half the time is left, and Coventry created the better chances. Most likely scores are now 0-0, 1-0, 1-1 (before kickoff: 1-0, 2-0, 1-1). Full-time corners lowered from 5.3/4.2 to 4.0/3.6 after a 1-1 first half. Fouls moved to Everton 10.5 (from 9.5) and Coventry 10.0 (from 12.5). Cards lowered after a card-free first half, but Attwell shows a lot of cards this season, so more are likely if the second half gets tight.

rules.zh: 1X2 以腳本模型基準為主：沒有具體的新資訊（主力傷停、確定陣容、市場賠率大幅變動）時，AI 對任何一個結果的機率調整不超過 ±8 個百分點；不要只因為「主場優勢」或「市場看好」就加碼。
rules.en: Anchor 1X2 on the scripted model baseline: without concrete new information (key absences, confirmed XI, big odds moves), keep AI adjustments within ±8 percentage points per outcome; do not add extra just for 'home edge' or 'market favourite'.
rules.evidence: 10 場累積 Brier：model 0.558 優於 AI 0.614、市場 0.628、基準 0.623；AI 加碼看好的熱門落空：Man City 55%（0-1）、Newcastle 41%（0-1）、Sunderland 38%（1-3）

rules.zh: 半場更新：比分仍是 0-0 時，不可單憑上半場 xG 把賽前熱門的勝率砍掉超過 15 個百分點；只領先一球而且 xG 差距 <0.5 時，領先方勝率上限約 60%，平局至少保留 25%。
rules.en: Half-time update: at 0-0, do not cut the pre-match favourite's win probability by more than 15 points based on first-half xG alone; with a one-goal lead and an xG gap <0.5, cap the leader at ~60% and keep the draw at ≥25%.
rules.evidence: 3 場半場判斷失準：Chelsea–Man United（0-0 時降到 24%，結果 2-0）、Hull City–Ipswich（客隊 58%，結果 2-2）、Aston Villa–Fulham（主隊 68%，結果 1-1）

rules.zh: 總進球預期比基準低約 0.4 球；主隊被看好而且客隊進攻弱時，比分選項把 1-0、2-0 排在 1-1、2-1 前面（主隊零失球的可能要計入）。
rules.en: Lower expected total goals by ~0.4 vs baseline; when the home side is favoured and the away attack is weak, rank 1-0 and 2-0 above 1-1 and 2-1 (allow for a home clean sheet).
rules.evidence: 總進球 bias +0.55（10 場）；10 場有 4 場是 2-0（Chelsea、Bournemouth、Brentford、Tottenham），而首選 1-1／2-1 多數假設雙方都進球

rules.zh: 兩隊實力接近而且預期進球偏少（總 λ<2.5）時，平局機率至少 28–30%。
rules.en: When the teams are evenly matched and expected goals are low (total λ<2.5), give the draw at least 28–30%.
rules.evidence: Aston Villa–Fulham（平局只給 26%，結果 1-1）、Hull City–Ipswich（2-2）；Coventry–Sunderland 是兩隊進攻都弱，結果和預期相反

rules.zh: 黃牌時段分配：上半場黃牌比基準減約 0.3 張，全場黃牌加約 0.5 張；強隊對決、執法偏嚴的裁判（如 Bankes）或者預期一方會追分時，全場再加 0.5–1 張，增加的部分集中在 60 分鐘以後。
rules.en: Card timing: lower first-half yellows by ~0.3 vs baseline and raise full-time yellows by ~0.5; add another 0.5–1 for big-team clashes, strict referees (e.g. Bankes) or when one side is expected to chase, concentrated after 60'.
rules.evidence: 上半場黃牌 bias +0.39、全場 −0.57（10 場）；Liverpool–Arsenal 8 張（7 張在下半場）、Chelsea–Man United 7 黃 1 紅、Hull City–Ipswich 下半場 5 張、Newcastle–Everton 3 張在 90 分鐘後

rules.zh: 犯規傾斜：如果一方先進球的機率明顯較高（≥55%），從這一方的預測犯規中移約 2 次給對手；落後追分的一方犯規和黃牌都較多。
rules.en: Foul skew: if one side is clearly more likely to score first (≥55%), move ~2 predicted fouls from that side to the opponent; the chasing side commits more fouls and collects more cards.
rules.evidence: Brentford 6 對 Nott'm Forest 17、Liverpool（落後）18 對 Arsenal 10、Man United（落後）20、Aston Villa 7；反例是 Coventry 領先後犯規 16 次，所以只作中度傾斜

rules.zh: 角球分布：預期一方控球 >60% 或明顯壓制時，強隊角球比基準加 1.5–2，被壓制一方減 1；一方早段落後時，角球向追分一方傾斜。只按兩隊打法決定是否上調，不要預設上調總角球。
rules.en: Corner split: when one side is expected to have >60% possession or clear dominance, add 1.5–2 corners to it and remove 1 from the opponent; after an early deficit, tilt corners toward the chasing side. Decide any upward adjustment from both teams' styles, never by default.
rules.evidence: 全場角球 bias −1.15；Man City–Brighton 8-2、Tottenham–Crystal Palace 20-0、Liverpool（落後）7-4、Hull City（落後）6-3；Newcastle–Everton 預設上調後反而估多，Brentford–Nott'm Forest 只有 7 個

rules.zh: 對手少一人時（半場更新或已知紅牌），強隊全場角球至少估 10–12 個，對手角球估 ≤2 個，犯規總數下調。
rules.en: When the opponent is down to ten men (half-time update or known red card), project the stronger side at 10–12+ corners and the opponent at ≤2, and lower total fouls.
rules.evidence: Tottenham–Crystal Palace（Mateta 13 分鐘被逐，角球 20-0，犯規只有 18 次，半場預測 11 個仍然太少）；Chelsea–Man United 紅牌後比賽一面倒

rules.zh: 主隊本季主場 xG 一直落後、或者剛在其他賽事輸給同一個對手時，主勝機率要明顯下調（至少 5–8 點），不要只看紙面上的主場優勢。
rules.en: If the home side has been losing the xG battle at home this season, or just lost to the same opponent in another competition, cut the home-win probability clearly (at least 5–8 points) rather than trusting the home edge on paper.
rules.evidence: Newcastle–Everton（4 天前聯賽杯 1-3 輸給 Everton，主場疲弱，仍給主勝 41%，結果 0-1，Everton xG 2.15 對 1.47）；Man City–Brighton 給強隊主勝 55% 也落空

playbook.summary_zh: 首次建立 9 條守則：1X2 以表現較好的模型基準為主，半場判斷不要過度跟隨 xG 或一球領先；下調總進球、保留平局；黃牌由上半場移到下半場並上調全場數量；犯規和角球按壓制方和追分方傾斜。
playbook.summary_en: First playbook, 9 rules: anchor 1X2 on the better-performing model baseline and avoid half-time overreaction to xG or one-goal leads; lower total goals and protect the draw; shift yellows from the first half to late in the match and raise the full-time total; skew fouls and corners by dominance and game state.
